source.title: The Savior of Kalimdor
source.description: To the Caverns of Time you go, <Lord/Lady> <name>. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.
source.objective: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
source.completion: The Master has left these for you, champion. From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.
